meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 装上后，处理 HyperFrames 视频项目时，Claude 会先确保技能为最新并读取项目状态，再按既定流程制作或修改多场景视频，产出可供审阅的剧情板。
howto.when: 当要制作或编辑多场景视频、品牌片、混剪等，且没有更专门的工作流可用；或 BRIEF.md 中 flow 为 companion 时触发。简短无旁白动态应改用 motion-graphics。

say.text: 帮我制作一支多场景品牌宣传片，先出计划。
say.note: Claude 会按多场景流程先规划再搭建。

say.text: 按 companion 模式，先给这版片子的完整设计方案。
say.note: 它会一次给全各层设计，再听你取舍。

say.text: 把第 2 个镜头剪成 3 秒硬切，其余不动。
say.note: 属于具体修改，不再重开需求调研。

howto.what_en: Once installed, for HyperFrames video projects Claude first checks that the skill is current and reads project state, then creates or edits multi-scene videos along the prescribed workflow, producing a storyboard for review.
howto.when_en: Use for creating/editing longer or multi-scene HyperFrames pieces when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Short motion-first units use motion-graphics instead.

say_en.text: Make a multi-scene brand promo video and show me the plan first.
say_en.note: It will plan first, then build scene by scene.

say_en.text: In companion mode, give me the full design treatment for this piece.
say_en.note: It lays out the design once, then lets you trim.

say_en.text: Cut scene 2 as a 3-second hard cut; keep everything else.
